title: Extract gateway_stream.go from gateway.go
description:
## What
Create `core/controlplane/gateway/gateway_stream.go` by moving WebSocket/streaming code OUT of `gateway.go`. Do this AFTER gateway_helpers.go is extracted.

## Exact items to move (by function/type name)

### Constants (move from existing const blocks)
- `wsAPIKeyProtocol` (currently line ~72)
- `wsWriteTimeout` (currently line ~74)

### Types & Vars
- `wsClient` struct (lines 154-159)
- `wsEvent` struct (lines 161-165)
- `upgrader` var — the `websocket.Upgrader{...}` (lines 167-170)

### Server Methods — Bus Tap Management
- `(s *server).stopBusTaps` (lines 145-152)
- `(s *server).startBusTaps` (lines 679-809) — large function, subscribes to heartbeats/DLQ/job events
- `(s *server).enqueueBusPacket` (lines 811-825)
- `(s *server).enqueueWSEvent` (lines 827-840)

### Server Methods — Workflow Job Results
- `(s *server).handleWorkflowJobResult` (lines 842-861)
- `splitWorkflowJobID` (lines 863-871)

### Server Methods — WebSocket Handlers
- `(s *server).handleStream` (lines 2349-2396)
- `(s *server).handleJobStream` (lines 2398-2458)

### WebSocket Auth Helpers
- `apiKeyFromWebSocket` (lines 2571-2587)
- `decodeWSAPIKey` (lines 2589-2601)

### Bus Packet Context Resolution
- `(s *server).tenantForBusPacket` (lines 2857-2881)
- `jobIDForBusPacket` (lines 2883-2900)
- `(s *server).tenantForJobID` (lines 2902-2922)

## How
1. Create new file `gateway_stream.go` with `package gateway`
2. Add necessary imports (determine from usage — `context`, `encoding/base64`, `encoding/json`, `log/slog`, `strings`, `sync`, `time`, plus `bus`, `pb`, `wf`, `gorilla/websocket`)
3. Move all listed items into the new file
4. Remove them from `gateway.go`
5. Run `go build ./cmd/cordum-api-gateway` — must compile

## Notes
- Line numbers reference the ORIGINAL gateway.go before any extractions. After gateway_helpers.go extraction, line numbers will have shifted — use function names to locate items.
- `startBusTaps` is ~130 lines and references `s.bus`, `s.sched`, `s.wfEngine`, `s.wsClients` — all on the server struct which stays in gateway_core.go. This is fine since same package.
definitionOfDone: gateway_stream.go exists with package gateway header
All listed streaming/WebSocket functions moved from gateway.go
gateway.go no longer contains any of the moved items

implementationPlan.description:
Create `gateway_stream.go` with package header, imports, and streaming constants/types.

1. Create file `core/controlplane/gateway/gateway_stream.go`
2. Add `package gateway`
3. Add imports (expect: `context`, `encoding/base64`, `encoding/json`, `fmt`, `log/slog`, `net/http`, `strings`, `time`, plus project imports: `bus/capsdk`, `protocol/pb`, `infra/memory` or job store interface, `workflow` engine, `gorilla/websocket`, and `cordum-io/cordum/internal/logging`)
4. Add streaming constants:
```go
const (
	wsAPIKeyProtocol = "cordum-api-key"
	wsWriteTimeout   = 5 * time.Second
)
```
5. Add types and vars:
- `wsClient` struct (lines 154-159)
- `wsEvent` struct (lines 161-165)
- `var upgrader = websocket.Upgrader{...}` (lines 167-170) — references `isAllowedOrigin` which stays in gateway.go (same package, fine)

**DO NOT move**: `shutdownTimeout` — it's used by `startHTTPServer` in core.

Move bus tap management methods into gateway_stream.go.

Cut from gateway.go and paste into gateway_stream.go:
- `(s *server).stopBusTaps` (lines 145-152)
- `(s *server).startBusTaps` (lines 679-809) — large function (~130 lines), subscribes to heartbeat/DLQ/job-result subjects. References `s.bus`, `s.sched`, `s.wfEngine`, `s.wsClients`, `s.workerMu`, `s.workers` — all on server struct which stays in gateway_core.go (same package access)
- `(s *server).enqueueBusPacket` (lines 811-825)
- `(s *server).enqueueWSEvent` (lines 827-840)
- `(s *server).handleWorkflowJobResult` (lines 842-861)
- `splitWorkflowJobID` (lines 863-871)

**Note**: After gateway_helpers.go was extracted, these line numbers will have shifted. Use function names to locate them.

Move WebSocket handler methods and auth helpers into gateway_stream.go.

Cut from gateway.go and paste into gateway_stream.go:
- `(s *server).handleStream` (lines 2349-2396) — full WebSocket upgrade + event loop for admin stream
- `(s *server).handleJobStream` (lines 2398-2458) — job-specific WebSocket stream
- `apiKeyFromWebSocket` (lines 2571-2587) — extracts API key from WS subprotocol
- `decodeWSAPIKey` (lines 2589-2601) — base64 decode helper for WS keys

**Note**: Line numbers are pre-extraction approximations. Use function names to locate.

Move bus packet context resolution helpers into gateway_stream.go.

Cut from gateway.go and paste into gateway_stream.go:
- `(s *server).tenantForBusPacket` (lines 2857-2881) — resolves tenant from bus packet
- `jobIDForBusPacket` (lines 2883-2900) — extracts job ID from bus packet
- `(s *server).tenantForJobID` (lines 2902-2922) — looks up tenant by job ID via jobStore

**Note**: Line numbers are pre-extraction. Use function names.

Clean up gateway.go: remove moved constants from the const block and unused imports.

1. Remove `wsAPIKeyProtocol` and `wsWriteTimeout` from the const block at lines ~72-74
2. Clean up import block — remove imports only used by moved streaming code (likely `encoding/base64`, `gorilla/websocket` if no other usage remains)
3. Verify no dangling references remain in gateway.go to moved functions

Run: `go build ./cmd/cordum-api-gateway` — must compile.

If build fails, fix missing imports in gateway_stream.go or duplicate removals in gateway.go.
